sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: This podcast is for English beginner listeners for A1 to A2 listeners.
sentences.tc: 該播客適合 A1 至 A2 的英語初學者聽眾。

sentences.en: Today I will be talking about sleep and rest.
sentences.tc: 今天我要談談睡眠和休息。

sentences.en: Today I woke up late not early but late.
sentences.tc: 今天我起床晚了，不是早，而是晚。

sentences.en: I woke up around 10 a.m. I was so sleepy.
sentences.tc: 上午10點左右我就醒了，我實在是太睏了。

sentences.en: I went to bed last night around 11 p.m.
sentences.tc: 我昨晚 11 點左右上床睡覺。

sentences.en: I woke up at 10 a.m. that means.
sentences.tc: 我早上 10 點就醒了，這意味著。

sentences.en: I had 11 hours of sleep last night.
sentences.tc: 我昨晚睡了 11 個小時。

sentences.en: I usually don't sleep that much but last night I was really really tired.
sentences.tc: 我通常睡得不多，但昨晚我真的很累。

sentences.en: I usually have a lot of energy.
sentences.tc: 我通常精力充沛。

sentences.en: I don't need too much sleep but lately maybe the past 3 days.
sentences.tc: 我不需要太多睡眠，但最近可能是過去三天。

sentences.en: I have been feeling very tired and sleepy.
sentences.tc: 我一直感到非常疲倦和困倦。

sentences.en: I haven't had so much energy lately.
sentences.tc: 我最近沒有那麼多精力。

sentences.en: I take care of myself and I try to get as much rest as.
sentences.tc: 我照顧好自己，盡量多休息。

sentences.en: I can like one of my students said a good night sleep is only half the battle.
sentences.tc: 我可以像我的一位學生所說的那樣，睡個好覺只是成功的一半。

sentences.en: As long as.
sentences.tc: 只要。

sentences.tc: 我睡了個好覺，我想其他一切都會很完美，很幸運。

sentences.en: I could sleep in late this morning.
sentences.tc: 今天早上我可以睡得很晚。

sentences.en: I didn't have any early morning lessons to teach.
sentences.tc: 我沒有任何早課可教。

sentences.en: I could sleep in late because I didn't have work but otherwise.
sentences.tc: 我可以睡得很晚，因為我沒有工作，但除此之外。

sentences.tc: 我通常每天早上八點起床去上課，這真是令人沮喪。

sentences.en: Sometimes to fall asleep.
sentences.tc: 有時為了睡覺。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's difficult for me to fall asleep at night.
sentences.tc: 有時我晚上很難入睡。

sentences.en: I just lay in bed and I wait.
sentences.tc: 我只是躺在床上等待。

phrases.meaning: 常用說法，可用來表達「need to」這個意思

examples.en: I don't need too much sleep but lately maybe the past 3 days.
examples.tc: 我不需要太多睡眠，但最近可能是過去三天。

phrases.meaning: 常用說法，可用來表達「try to」這個意思

examples.en: I take care of myself and I try to get as much rest as.
examples.tc: 我照顧好自己，盡量多休息。

phrases.meaning: 常用說法，可用來表達「i think」這個意思

examples.en: I get a good night sleep I think everything else will be perfect and luckily.
examples.tc: 我睡了個好覺，我想其他一切都會很完美，很幸運。
